Sourav Ganguly Nearly Resigned Over April Fool's Prank

Former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly reportedly offered to resign from his captaincy after a prank by teammates Sachin Tendulkar and Rahul Dravid. The incident, described as an April Fool's joke, occurred during a team meeting. Ganguly's reaction was so strong that he threatened to step down. The other players involved in the prank were Tendulkar and Dravid.
